probes.response: A hash table stores key-value pairs by mapping keys directly to memory locations using an algorithm called a hash function instead of comparing values sequentially one after another. This internal calculation converts each search key straight into the exact array index, allowing the system to jump immediately to the specific bucket holding the corresponding value without inspecting other elements first. Consequently, lookup operations occur in constant time regardless of how large the stored dataset grows within the structure.
